svg.title: One Cohort, Five Evidence Filters
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-single-cohort-sourcing-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: One Cohort, Five Evidence Filters; subtitle: An illustrative 120-target search cohort narrows to two signed LOIs.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Counts describe one hypothetical cohort observed through a common cutoff, not monthly throughput or an industry benchmark. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage. A signed LOI does not establish a completed acquisition.; caption: Stage conversions are 40%, 50%, 33.33%, and 25%; cumulative target-to-LOI conversion is 2 / 120 = 1.67%.; stages: label: Qualified targets; value: 120 businesses fit the buy box; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Deduplicate broker and direct-owner leads in Airtable; record business identity, geography, sector, and a specific reason the ownership model fits.; label: Owner conversations; value: 48 of 120 targets; 40% conversion; numeric value: 48.0; detail: Confirm seller authority, transition intentions, expected timing, and willingness to provide operating records before requesting confidential customer-level material.; label: Usable data rooms; value: 24 of 48 conversations; 50% conversion; numeric value: 24.0; detail: Execute confidentiality terms and obtain sufficient ledger, payroll, tax, and receivables records to compare the seller narrative with recorded operating activity.; label: Diligence-ready candidates; value: 8 of 24 data rooms; 33.33% conversion; numeric value: 8.0; detail: Complete preliminary earnings normalization, concentration review, and debt-service stress testing; reserve full third-party QoE expenditure for the selected transaction.; label: Signed LOIs; value: 2 of 8 candidates; 25% conversion; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Negotiate price mechanics, exclusivity, diligence access, and closing conditions sequentially where capacity demands; neither LOI is counted as revenue or a closed deal.

circle.title: label: Qualified targets; value: 120 businesses fit the buy box; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Deduplicate broker and direct-owner leads in Airtable; record business identity, geography, sector, and a specific reason the ownership model fits.

label: Owner conversations; value: 48 of 120 targets; 40% conversion; numeric value: 48.0; detail: Confirm seller authority, transition intentions, expected timing, and willingness to provide operating records before requesting confidential customer-level material.

label: Usable data rooms; value: 24 of 48 conversations; 50% conversion; numeric value: 24.0; detail: Execute confidentiality terms and obtain sufficient ledger, payroll, tax, and receivables records to compare the seller narrative with recorded operating activity.

label: Diligence-ready candidates; value: 8 of 24 data rooms; 33.33% conversion; numeric value: 8.0; detail: Complete preliminary earnings normalization, concentration review, and debt-service stress testing; reserve full third-party QoE expenditure for the selected transaction.

label: Signed LOIs; value: 2 of 8 candidates; 25% conversion; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Negotiate price mechanics, exclusivity, diligence access, and closing conditions sequentially where capacity demands; neither LOI is counted as revenue or a closed deal.

text.title: Assumptions: Counts describe one hypothetical cohort observed through a common cutoff, not monthly throughput or an industry benchmark. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage. A signed LOI does not establish a completed acquisition.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Counts describe one hypothetical cohort observed through a common cutoff, not monthly throughput or an industry
